scenarios.title: Unresponsive Collapse
scenarios.description: Someone near you suddenly collapses and is unresponsive. What is your very first step?

choices.text: Check for scene safety and call emergency services
choices.feedback: Correct! Always ensure the area is safe first and call for professional help.

choices.text: Give them a glass of water immediately
choices.feedback: Giving water to an unconscious person presents a severe choking hazard.

choices.text: Wait 10 minutes to see if they wake up
choices.feedback: Immediate action is crucial in medical emergencies.
